title: Turkish Kisir Salad
description: A traditional Turkish salad made with bulgur, vegetables, and spices. Kisir is a refreshing and flavorful side dish or light meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine bulgur and 2 cups of water. Let it soak for 30 minutes.
Drain the bulgur and rinse it with cold water.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the kisir and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked bulgur to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and garnish with parsley.
